items.text: NY Jets QB: Geno Smith (ankle) limited Wednesday and seen limping; says starting is 'the plan'; Aaron Glenn: 'We'll see how the week goes.' Jets' preview says he remains in line for his 11th straight start. Rookie Cade Klubnik starts if not. Check Friday status.

NY Jets (Wed): DNP - WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip, in doubt), DL Harrison Phillips (ankle), WR Isaiah Williams (ribs). LIMITED - EDGE Joseph Ossai, G Dylan Parham (knee), LB Trevin Wallace (groin), DL David Onyemata (IR return window). IR - OT Max Mitchell, DT T'Vondre Sweat, WR Arian Smith.

LA Chargers (Wed): DNP - LB Daiyan Henley (knee), TE Charlie Kolar (concussion), WR Brenen Thompson (hamstring), DBs Rodney Shelley and Isas Waxter; OLB Khalil Mack rest. LIMITED - WR Ladd McConkey (back), CB Donte Jackson (groin), DT Justin Eboigbe, OT Trey Pipkins (IR return window). IR - S Derwin James Jr., OT Rashawn Slater. Justin Herbert starts.
